churches.name: Trinity Gospel Church
churches.overall_label: RED — rejects eternal generation and procession (against the Nicene Creed); treats symmetrical reprobation as a gospel essential
churches.assessment: Trinity Gospel Church is an independent Sovereign Grace assembly in Lexington, KY, meeting at 1938 Stanton Way. Its own Beliefs page affirms the full deity of Christ, the hypostatic union and justification by faith alone. The same page explicitly rejects the eternal generation of the Son and the eternal procession of the Spirit "despite what the Nicene Creed posits," which places it outside Nicene Trinitarian orthodoxy. It also makes symmetrical, active reprobation a "gospel essential" and calls Arminian views heretical. The rating is red for significant concerns. It is not black: the page plainly affirms Christ's deity, so this is not an anti-Trinitarian body.
churches.enrichment_notes:
[2026-11-26] Added via Principal order CCW-1126-DIR (high confidence). Existence evidence: https://www.trinitygospelchurchky.com/. Pastor "Sonny Hernandez" taken verbatim from that roster entry. Doctrine not yet reviewed.
[2026-11-26] CCW-1126-DIR manual grade from the church's own pages: Street address 1938 Stanton Way, Lexington, KY 40511 (hotel conference room) taken from the church's own homepage contact section. Sonny Hernandez is listed as leader because he authors the church's doctrinal posts and preaches on its YouTube channel ("Trinity Gospel Church, Lexington KY"). The fetched pages do not give him an explicit "Pastor" title, so needs_review stays true.

score_notes.christology: The church's own Beliefs page says: "The immanent Trinity has no hierarchy, superiority, subordination, derivation, begetting, or procession." It also says "the person of the Son did not derive from the Father 'before all worlds' (Eternal Generation), and the person of the Spirit did not originate from the Father in eternity (Eternal Procession), despite what the Nicene Creed posits." This is an explicit rejection of the Nicene confession of the Son as "begotten of the Father before all worlds." The page does affirm the full deity of the Son and Spirit, the hypostatic union, two wills, and the bodily resurrection. It is not Arian, but it is outside Nicene orthodoxy. Red. Source: trinitygospelchurchky.com/beliefs
score_notes.scripture: Own Beliefs page affirms the Bible as inerrant, infallible, sufficient and providentially preserved. It also defends the Comma Johanneum (1 John 5:7-8 KJV) on its homepage. Yellow, because the page explicitly sets this against "a fallible creed."
score_notes.soteriology: Own Beliefs page affirms sola fide and imputed righteousness. It also says God has "an unremitting hatred for the reprobate," says grace is "not universal ... or common," calls Arminian views "heretical," and says active, unconditional reprobation is one of the "gospel essentials." Making equal-ultimacy reprobation a test of salvation goes beyond confessional Reformed soteriology (WCF, 1689 LBC). Red.
score_notes.gender: No statement on church offices was found on the pages fetched. The only named leader is male.
score_notes.leadership: Sonny Hernandez is the author of the church's doctrinal posts and the preacher on its sermon channel. The site does not publish an elder roster or give him a pastoral title on the pages fetched.
score_notes.preaching: Doctrinal sermon series (Trinity, Christology, Doctrines of Grace) are listed on the site and its YouTube channel. Not reviewed for this grade.
score_notes.mission: Small assembly meeting in a hotel conference room (Quality Inn / Mainstay Suites, Salon A), Sundays 11:00 AM (contact section of the church's own site).
score_notes.denominational: Independent "Sovereign Grace Assembly." No denominational oversight is stated.
